DS3 VR 2.0.0: NVIDIA DLSS and DLAA, a wider world scale, a tabbed VR menu and better frame rates.

**New**
- **NVIDIA DLSS (RTX graphics cards).** VR menu, Graphics tab:
  - **DLAA** smooths jagged edges and shimmering at full resolution. It switches on and off while you play.
  - **Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Perf** upscaling: the game renders each eye smaller and DLSS rebuilds it at your headset's resolution, for more frame rate. These apply the next time you start the game.
  - DLSS works with geo-11's stereo: each eye gets its own DLSS pass with its own motion data, so both eyes stay matched.
  - **DLSS model:** CNN (default, fastest) or Transformer.
  - The two NVIDIA files come in the zip's `ds3vr` folder; nothing extra to download.
- **Sharpening** (Graphics tab, Off to Max): AMD's contrast-adaptive sharpening on the headset image. Works with or without DLSS. Off by default.
- **World scale from 0.25 to 10** in half steps (was 1 to 5). Below 1.0 the world looks bigger than life.
- **Decoupled pitch** (was Horizon lock), now with three settings: Off, Level (the horizon stays level; the right stick still raises and lowers the camera) and Level + stick lock (the stick's up and down is ignored).
- **Tabbed VR menu:** General, Graphics and Developer tabs, switched with LB / RB or LT / RT. The panel keeps the same size, so it fits every HUD mode. New look in Dark Souls III's font and colours.
- **Better sizing on a new install:** the first launch now tries to read your headset's resolution before the game starts, instead of starting oversized. If it does not arrive in time, the game can crash or start at the wrong size; launching a second time fixes it (see Troubleshooting in the README).

**Fixed**
- **Frame rate dropping after opening the VR menu.** Each time the menu opened, it started a helper program that connected to SteamVR as a second VR app; memory use doubled and the frame rate fell by about 10 fps until the game was closed. The menu no longer does this. The resolution check at startup is unchanged.

**Moved**
- Pose lag is now on the Developer tab (it is a timing fix, not a comfort setting). Head movement is on the General tab.

**Updating from 1.0.x:** extract the new zip into the `Game` folder and overwrite the old files. You do not need to run `install-ds3vr.bat` again. Your settings are kept; Horizon lock "on" becomes Decoupled pitch "Level".

**New install:** extract `DS3VR-2.0.0.zip` into the game's `Game` folder (the one with `DarkSoulsIII.exe`), run `install-ds3vr.bat`, start your VR runtime, then launch Dark Souls III from Steam. Full instructions are in `ds3vr\README.txt`.

**Runtimes:** thoroughly tested on SteamVR. Virtual Desktop (VDXR), Meta and PimaxXR should work but have not been fully tested yet; reports are welcome.

**Credits:** NVIDIA DLSS by NVIDIA Corporation. Contrast-adaptive sharpening by AMD (FidelityFX CAS). geo-11 by davegl1234 and the HelixMod team; the Dark Souls 3 geo-11 fix by Helifax, updated by masterotaku.
